assumptions: User identifies crayon as an object category absent from policy training; other three categories are seen.
User confirms collection time and order do not affect outcomes.
Conditional label exchangeability and independent trial outcomes are required for permutation inference.
Matching uses object-position blocks; repeat numbers do not establish identical initial states.
limits: DP uses 16 DDIM steps for seen objects and 24 for crayon; execution is asynchronous while ACT, RGBQtoken, segNoQtoken and viewQtoken are synchronous.
One held-out object category supports a crayon-specific generalization result, not arbitrary unseen objects.

Saved labels are authoritative. User confirmed the segNoQtoken cube (1,0) trial 1 as failure despite automatic success, and paperball (3,0) trial 1 as invalid interruption; the latter is excluded and replaced by a new valid trial. Videos were not manually rescored.
Twenty association checks use Holm adjustment; axis findings are exploratory.
Two repeats per method-object-position cell do not establish a precise long-run cell success rate.
No causal mechanism or training-distribution coverage can be established from outcome metadata.
The difference of ablation gains is descriptive only; no factorial interaction significance test or multi-training-seed inference is claimed.

RGBQtoken includes 49 video-backed and 47 image-backed recordings; no recording is excluded by storage format. Timing is measured end-to-end control duration or logged chunk inference latency, not an isolated neural-network benchmark.
No method-by-position interaction test was performed; separate within-method significance levels do not prove an interaction.
VIOLA is excluded by user request. The semantically near-region cube failure follows the user-confirmed saved label; the invalid manually stopped paperball run is excluded.

methodology.association: Squared pooled success-count dispersion; position test shuffles outcomes within objects; object test within positions; x within object-y; y within object-x; 200000 draws with plus-one correction.
methodology.method: Exact convolution of hypergeometric assignments within each object-position block, 2 trials per method; two-sided success-count difference.
